name: denorm_preserve
description: Gradual underflow for requested floating-point preservation modes.
cost_note: FP16 uses native half arithmetic; FP32 replaces most arithmetic and comparisons with software; FP64 uses software binary64. About 7x GPU time was reported for a workload requesting FP32 preservation. Per-operation cost is unmeasured.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires both FP32 denorm controls for SM 6.2 and higher; only shaders requesting the modes pay the cost, and DXC default fp32 denorm mode any requests neither.
off_consequence: Without either FP32 denorm control, vkd3d-proton limits non-NVIDIA D3D12 devices to SM 6.1; SM 6.2 and higher are unavailable.

name: denorm_flush
description: Flush subnormal results to zero in requested floating-point modes.
cost_note: FP32 adds exponent-mask fixups to selected operations; no full software FP32 replacement. Per-operation cost is unmeasured. FTZ16 and FTZ64 are unsupported.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires both FP32 denorm controls for SM 6.2 and higher; only shaders requesting the modes pay the cost, and DXC default fp32 denorm mode any requests neither.
off_consequence: Without either FP32 denorm control, vkd3d-proton limits non-NVIDIA D3D12 devices to SM 6.1; SM 6.2 and higher are unavailable.

name: ray_tracing
description: Acceleration structures, ray queries and continuation-based ray-tracing pipelines.
cost_note: AS construction and traversal use compute and continuation dispatch. Work is selected by RT commands and shaders. Runtime cost is unmeasured.

property_bits.subgroupSupportedStages: VK_SHADER_STAGE_RAYGEN_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_ANY_HIT_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_CLOSEST_HIT_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_MISS_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_INTERSECTION_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_CALLABLE_BIT_KHR

off_consequence: Vulkan acceleration-structure, ray-query and ray-tracing pipeline interfaces and D3D12 DXR are unavailable; the RTXPT DXR path cannot run.

name: pixel_interlock
description: Pixel interlock with cross-sample ordering for multisampled rendering.
cost_note: Sample interlock and single-sample pixel interlock use native raster order groups. Multisample pixel interlock captures coverage and inputs, then performs ordered load/replay/store passes in bounded tile and primitive batches with CPU/GPU continuation sequencing and scratch clearing. Cost scales with actual coverage, sample count and batch count; per-use runtime cost is unmeasured.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires pixel and sample interlock for ROV support and D3D FL12_1; the multisample envelope is selected only for shaders using pixel interlock with multisampling.
off_consequence: Pixel interlock is unavailable, including its native single-sample route; vkd3d-proton loses ROV support and D3D FL12_1. Native sample interlock and ordered color attachment access remain available.

name: pipeline_statistics
description: Stage-dependent pipeline statistics for explicitly active queries.
cost_note: Inactive fragment and pre-geometry counter regions specialize away. An active fragment invocation loads its counter address and performs one low-word device atomic, with a high-word atomic on overflow. Active IA and geometry queries use their selected report paths. GPU timing is unmeasured.
performance_reason: The macfx-vkd3d translator requires pipelineStatisticsQuery for D3D feature level 11_0; inactive queries retain the default-false shader specialization.
off_consequence: Core Vulkan pipeline-statistics queries are unavailable. The macfx-vkd3d feature-level 11_0 capability check fails. This entry does not disable shader demote, helper invocation semantics, mesh queries or primitives-generated queries.
